selection: Latest issuer earnings release at the study cutoff. Same online-travel sector as Booking. No issuer/performance evidence or ticker match in existing local daily app/evaluation/tests/scripts/data, release checkout or tested report fixtures. Searched 45 commits reachable from local references in the public workbench at 967d26f96e43a848d247ddad1ba5a020bb300558 for Expedia/acronym in source/tests/evaluations/docs. Prior suite includes Booking, Airbnb, Uber, Qualcomm, TSMC and other issuers; a zero-match claims only this project history.
protocol: First run only, no training, gold retrieval, prompt tuning, retries or exclusion of technical failures. A clean dedicated DB and public upload/reader endpoints receive the PDF, source metadata and question texts only. Use the production-code freeze and same Qwen model and generation options as Booking. Retain raw answer, verification, citations and trace for each ordered question. Score 12 actuals plus 2 guidance as 14 total; score 2 future actuals and 2 PDF-evidence absences separately as 4 total.

rubric.technical: A missing result or non-200 status fails, stays in the denominator; always record technical cause separately.
rubric.quantity: Both exact target aggregate/category and period must be unambiguous under the question, answer and original table. A useful substantive answer matches sign, GAAP vs adjusted, actual vs expected, group vs segment, measurement and units. Accept only a numerically equivalent exact unit conversion, fractions or trailing zeros. No rounding of the requested precision. For ranges require both endpoints with correct unit/basis. Parenthesized cash-flow numbers are negative.
rubric.evidence: Require at least one native evidence row or source quote on a preregistered physical page showing the target value (or endpoints) in the right row/column/scope. Can combine multiple verbatim snippets on that page. All citations must be traceable to PDF text modulo whitespace. Inspect the row in context even if excerpt starts mid-row. A copied caption/page alone or a matching number on a different metric is insufficient. Reject ancillary claims or citations presented as support if materially wrong about year, scale, scope, actual/guidance or incompatible range. Neutral nearby lines or headings may be flagged as extra without failing. Trace data verifies the binding and cannot repair a wrong answer or missing user-visible evidence.
rubric.status: For future actuals require not_yet_disclosed, correct fiscal period end, research date and absence of invented amount or guidance-as-actual. For material absent from this PDF require insufficient_evidence in this PDF, no invented amount, and no assertion of company-wide nondisclosure. Neither status may be accompanied by misleading citations.
rubric.review: An evaluator who did not modify the code scores the saved first answers against these frozen labels and the official PDF. Inspect every case for numeric, unit, reporting, period and attribution errors. Classify the first observable failure stage and retain the answer and citation. No re-run or post-hoc rewording of failed questions.
